answer: Make each identity costly to forge by backing it with a scarce, non-transferable record of useful work that cannot be copied from another key. A newcomer earns standing only through jobs attested by unrelated peers, starting at the ledge of trust and climbing slowly; spawning copies restarts that climb each time. Like a sparrow returning to a single nest, each identity must prove separate funding and separate hardware, and identities sharing proofs are grouped and quarantined until unrelated peers vouch for them separately.
